svg.aria-label: The layers of a modern cloud data warehouse or lakehouse. At the bottom, object storage holds files. A file format such as Parquet or ORC lays out each file column by column. A table format such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake tracks which files make up a table, giving transactions, schema changes and time travel. A catalog such as Unity or Polaris names the tables and controls access. Query engines such as Spark, Trino, DuckDB or Snowflake sit on top and can all read the same tables.
